jql: issuetype=Test AND summary ~ "TC - [A11y]" AND status != Dropped

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.1 Text Alternatives - 1.1.1 Non-text Content
tests.description: Guideline 1.1  Text Alternatives: Provide text alternatives for any non-text content Success Criterion  1.1.1 Non-text Content  (Level A)

steps.action: Verify functional images (buttons, links) with accessibility inspector
steps.data: axe-core (wcag111): aria-meter-name, aria-progressbar-name, image-alt, input-image-alt, object-alt, role-img-alt, svg-img-alt
steps.result: Functional images must describe the action or destination, not just the visual image

steps.action: Review complex images (charts, diagrams) and look for extended descriptions
steps.result: Complex images must have accessible long description via longdesc, aria-describedby, or adjacent text

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.1 Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
tests.description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.1 Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)

steps.action: Inspect prerecorded audio-only and video-only media to verify a text transcript or audio track is provided adjacent to the player
steps.result: Every prerecorded audio-only or video-only clip provides an accessible link or expandable section containing the full text alternative

steps.action: Verify that transcript includes speaker identification and relevant sounds
steps.result: Transcript must be complete, identify who is speaking, and describe important sounds for comprehension

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.2 Captions (Prerecorded)
tests.description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.2 Captions (Prerecorded)

steps.action: Play prerecorded video content with audio and enable closed captions using keyboard and pointer controls
steps.result: Captions are available, can be toggled on/off via accessible controls, and display all dialogue

steps.action: Verify caption synchronization and accuracy with audio
steps.result: Captions must appear synchronized with audio, without significant errors, covering relevant sound effects

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.3 Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
tests.description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.3 Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)

steps.action: Play videos with essential visual content and verify descriptions
steps.result: Audio description or text alternative must exist describing important visual information

steps.action: Verify that alternative covers all critical visual elements for comprehension
steps.result: Description must include actions, expressions, scene changes, and unspoken on-screen text

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.4 Captions (Live)
tests.description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.4 Captions (Live)

steps.action: Access live broadcasts if available
steps.result: Live broadcasts must have real-time captioning

steps.action: Verify accuracy and acceptable delay of live captions
steps.result: Captions must reflect spoken audio with reasonable accuracy and minimal delay (maximum 3-5 seconds)

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.5 Audio Description (Prerecorded)
tests.description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.5 Audio Description (Prerecorded)

steps.action: Identify prerecorded videos containing essential visual information not conveyed in audio
steps.result: Videos must include audio description covering actions, characters, scene changes, and relevant visual elements

steps.action: Play video with audio description enabled and verify synchronization
steps.result: Audio description must be inserted in natural pauses without overlapping main audio

steps.action: Verify that audio description covers all critical visual elements
steps.result: Essential visual information must be fully described for blind or low vision users

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.6 Sign Language (Prerecorded)
tests.description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.6 Sign Language (Prerecorded) General Objective: To verify that pre-recorded video content with audio provides extended audio descriptions when necessary to understand the content. This test case verifies whether a pre-recorded video on the web site provides extended audio descriptions at times necessary to understand the content. Extended audio descriptions provide information about actions, characters, scenes, and on-screen information that cannot be understood from the original audio of the pre-recorded video alone. Expected Result: The pre-recorded video with audio provides extended audio descriptions at times necessary to understand the content. The extended audio descriptions can be activated and provide additional information that is not available in the original audio of the video.

steps.action: Identify prerecorded audio content (videos with narration or dialogue)
steps.result: Videos must include sign language interpretation visible on screen or activatable

steps.action: Verify visibility and size of sign language interpreter
steps.result: Interpreter must be clearly visible, with adequate contrast and sufficient size to distinguish signs

steps.action: Verify synchronization between audio and sign language
steps.result: Sign interpretation must be synchronized with spoken audio without significant delays

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.7 Extended Audio Description (Prerecorded)
tests.description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.7 Extended Audio Description (Prerecorded)

steps.action: Identify videos where natural pauses are insufficient for audio description
steps.result: Video must automatically pause to allow extended audio description of complex visual information

steps.action: Play video with extended audio description and verify pauses
steps.result: Video must pause when needed to describe visual elements, then continue automatically

steps.action: Verify user control over extended audio description
steps.result: User must be able to enable or disable extended audio description per preference

steps.action: Confirm that extended description does not interfere with content comprehension
steps.result: Pauses and descriptions must integrate naturally without causing confusion or loss of narrative context

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.8 Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
tests.description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.8 Media Alternative (Prerecorded)

steps.action: Locate prerecorded videos and verify availability of complete text document
steps.result: A complete text transcript must exist including dialogues, visual descriptions, and relevant sounds

steps.action: Review that text alternative describes complete sequence of visual events
steps.result: Document must function as independent alternative, describing all essential visual information chronologically

steps.action: Verify accessibility of text alternative
steps.result: Transcript must be in accessible format (HTML, structured document) near the original video

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.2 Time-based Media - 1.2.9 Audio-only (Live)
tests.description: Guideline 1.2  Provide alternatives for time-based media. Success Criteria:    1.2.9 Audio-only (Live)

steps.action: Access live audio-only broadcast (podcast, web radio, conference)
steps.result: An equivalent alternative must be presented synchronized with the live audio

steps.action: Verify delivery method of synchronized alternative
steps.result: Alternative can be real-time transcript, synchronized text description, or updated equivalent content

steps.action: Verify that alternative captures essential information from live audio
steps.result: Text content must reflect critical audio information with minimal acceptable delay

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.3 Adaptable - 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
tests.description: Guideline 1.3  Create content that can be presented in different ways (for example simpler layout) without losing information or structure. Success Criteria:    1.3.1 Info and Relationships

steps.action: Verify forms with programmatically associated labels
steps.data: axe-core (wcag131): aria-hidden-body, aria-required-children, aria-required-parent, definition-list, dlitem, list, listitem, td-headers-attr, th-has-data-cells, p-as-heading, table-fake-caption, td-has-header
steps.result: Each input must have label with for attribute or be wrapped in label, visible to screen readers

steps.action: Review related field groups with fieldset and legend
steps.result: Control groups (radio buttons, checkboxes) must be grouped with fieldset and descriptive legend

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.3 Adaptable - 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence
tests.description: Guideline 1.3  Create content that can be presented in different ways (for example simpler layout) without losing information or structure. Success Criteria:    1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence

steps.action: Navigate the site using only Tab and verify reading order
steps.result: Tab and DOM order must match the logical visual order of content

steps.action: Use screen reader to verify content reading order
steps.result: Reading order must be logical and coherent, without confusing jumps caused by CSS positioning

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.3 Adaptable - 1.3.3 Sensory Characteristics
tests.description: Guideline 1.3  Create content that can be presented in different ways (for example simpler layout) without losing information or structure. Success Criteria:    1.3.3 Sensory Characteristics

steps.action: Identify instructions that use only shape, color, or position
steps.result: Instructions must include descriptive text in addition to visual references (e.g., 'green Submit button' not just 'green button')

steps.action: Verify that critical information does not rely solely on sensory elements
steps.result: Errors, alerts, or process steps must be communicated with text in addition to color, icons, or sounds

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.3 Adaptable - 1.3.4 Orientation
tests.description: Guideline 1.3  Create content that can be presented in different ways (for example simpler layout) without losing information or structure. Success Criteria:    1.3.4 Orientation

steps.action: Rotate the viewport between Portrait (390x844) and Landscape (812x375) orientations and inspect CSS/JS restrictions
steps.result: Content and functionality adapt to both portrait and landscape orientations without CSS rotation locks or screen.orientation.lock() restrictions

steps.action: Verify that content is not locked to a single orientation
steps.result: Application must not force specific orientation unless essential (e.g., piano app, bank check)

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.3 Adaptable - 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose
tests.description: Guideline 1.3  Create content that can be presented in different ways (for example simpler layout) without losing information or structure. Success Criteria:    1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose

steps.action: Inspect form fields in source code
steps.result: Common fields (name, email, phone) must have appropriate autocomplete attribute

steps.action: Test autocomplete with browser saved data
steps.result: Fields with correct autocomplete must suggest user saved values when typing begins

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.3 Adaptable - 1.3.6 Identify Purpose
tests.description: Guideline 1.3  Create content that can be presented in different ways (for example simpler layout) without losing information or structure. Success Criteria:    1.3.6 Identify Purpose

steps.action: Review complex UI components and verify programmatic purpose
steps.result: Components must identify their purpose through ARIA attributes or HTML semantics for assistive technologies

steps.action: Verify icons and interactive elements with accessibility inspector
steps.result: Buttons, links, and icons must expose their function through appropriate roles and accessible names

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.1 Use of Color
tests.description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.1 Use of Color

steps.action: Inspect links within blocks of text, form validation errors, charts, and status indicators to verify non-color visual cues
steps.result: Links in text have underlines or a 3:1 contrast ratio with surrounding text plus a non-color hover/focus indicator, and statuses include icons, patterns, or text labels

steps.action: Test site in grayscale mode or with color blindness simulator
steps.result: All information must remain comprehensible without relying on color to distinguish elements

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.2 Audio Control
tests.description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.2 Audio Control

steps.action: Load the page and observe whether any audio plays automatically for more than 3 seconds
steps.result: Audio either does not start automatically, stops within 3 seconds, or provides a dedicated mechanism at the top of the page to pause, stop, or mute it independently of system volume

steps.action: Verify that audio control is keyboard accessible
steps.result: Control must be operable without mouse, using Tab and Enter/Space

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)
tests.description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)

steps.action: Verify contrast in all states (normal, hover, focus, disabled)
steps.result: All interactive element states must meet required contrast ratios

steps.action: Review text over images or gradient backgrounds
steps.result: Overlaid text must have sufficient contrast throughout or use shadows/overlays

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.4 Resize Text
tests.description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.4 Resize text

steps.action: Increase browser zoom and root text size up to 200% and inspect all text containers and meta viewport attributes
steps.result: The meta viewport does not disable user scaling (no user-scalable=no or maximum-scale<2) and all text scales up to 200% without clipping, overlap, or loss of content

steps.action: Verify that controls and buttons remain operable when zoomed
steps.result: Interactive elements must not be clipped or hidden when text size is increased

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.5 Images of Text
tests.description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.5 Images of Text

steps.action: Identify text rendered as image
steps.result: Text must be in real HTML, not images (except logos or special cases)

steps.action: Inspect graphics and banners for embedded text
steps.result: Titles, labels, and informative text must be CSS-styled HTML text, not images

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.6 Contrast (Enhanced)
tests.description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.6 Contrast (Enhanced)

steps.action: Measure foreground-to-background contrast ratios across normal text and large text against AAA thresholds
steps.result: Normal text achieves a contrast ratio of at least 7:1 and large text (>=24px or >=18.66px bold) achieves at least 4.5:1

steps.action: Document exceptions and plan contrast improvements
steps.result: Identify areas not meeting AAA and prioritize changes in most critical elements

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.7 Low or No Background Audio
tests.description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.7 Low or No Background Audio

steps.action: Play audio content and evaluate background sound presence
steps.result: Background audio must be removable, 20dB lower than main audio, or non-existent

steps.action: Verify control to disable background music if present
steps.result: User must be able to mute or reduce ambient audio without affecting main narration

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.8 Visual Presentation
tests.description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.8 Visual Presentation

steps.action: Verify if user can customize spacing, column width, alignment, and fonts
steps.result: System must allow visual presentation adjustments without loss of functionality or content

steps.action: Test readability with OS settings (text size, high contrast)
steps.result: Content must respect user preferences defined at system level

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.9 Images of Text (No Exception)
tests.description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.9 Images of Text (No Exception)

steps.action: Thoroughly review entire site for text rendered as images
steps.result: No text in image format must exist, all must be real HTML text (no exceptions except logos)

steps.action: Inspect decorative elements and verify text is styled with CSS
steps.result: Visual text effects must be achieved with CSS, not by converting text to images

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.10 Reflow
tests.description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.10 Reflow

steps.action: Resize window to 320px width or zoom to 400%
steps.result: Horizontal scrolling must not be required to read content (except complex tables)

steps.action: Test on real mobile device with narrow viewport
steps.result: All content must adapt fluidly without clipping or need for bidirectional scrolling

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast
tests.description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.11 Non-text Contrast

steps.action: Measure contrast of UI components and focus states
steps.result: Minimum 3:1 contrast for component borders, functional icons, and focus indicators

steps.action: Verify contrast of informative graphic elements (charts, status icons)
steps.result: Visual elements conveying information must be clearly distinguishable from background

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.12 Text Spacing
tests.description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.12 Text Spacing

steps.action: Apply WCAG text spacing overrides (line-height: 1.5, letter-spacing: 0.12em, word-spacing: 0.16em, paragraph margin-bottom: 2em)
steps.result: All text blocks apply the spacing overrides without being blocked by inline !important styles and without horizontal scroll or clipped text

steps.action: Verify that buttons and controls do not break with modified spacing
steps.result: Interactive elements must maintain functionality and readability with custom spacing

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 1.4 Distinguishable - 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus
tests.description: Guideline 1.4  Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background. Success Criteria:    1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus

steps.action: Activate tooltips and popup content with hover and keyboard
steps.result: Additional content must be keyboard accessible, remain visible, and be dismissible without moving pointer

steps.action: Verify that popup content does not disappear when moving pointer over it
steps.result: User must be able to move cursor over tooltip to read or interact without it disappearing

steps.action: Verify accessible dismiss mechanism (ESC or close button)
steps.result: Popup content must be dismissible without moving pointer from the trigger that activated it

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.1 Keyboard Accessible - 2.1.1 Keyboard
tests.description: Guideline 2.1  All functionality of the content is operable through a keyboard interface without requiring specific timings for individual keystrokes, except where the underlying function requires input that depends on the path of the user's movement and not just the endpoints. Success Criteria: 2.1.1 Keyboard

steps.action: Test complex components (accordions, tabs, calendars)
steps.result: Custom widgets must respond to appropriate keys (arrows, Home, End, Escape)

steps.action: Verify all mouse actions have keyboard equivalent
steps.result: Drag and drop, hover menus, touch gestures must have keyboard-operable alternatives

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.1 Keyboard Accessible - 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap
tests.description: Guideline 2.1  All functionality of the content is operable through a keyboard interface without requiring specific timings for individual keystrokes, except where the underlying function requires input that depends on the path of the user's movement and not just the endpoints. Success Criteria: 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap

steps.action: Navigate the entire page/component using only Tab and Shift+Tab
steps.result: Focus must move through all interactive elements and exit freely without being trapped

steps.action: Test modals, dialogs, and overlays with keyboard navigation
steps.result: Focus must move freely within the component and it must be closable via Esc or a keyboard-accessible close control

steps.action: If content requires non-standard keys to exit focus, verify users are informed
steps.result: Instructions for un-trapping focus must be visibly provided

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.1 Keyboard Accessible - 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception)
tests.description: Guideline 2.1  Make all functionality available from a keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception)

steps.action: Navigate and operate every interactive component and custom widget using only the keyboard without exception
steps.result: All page functionality is operable through a keyboard interface without requiring specific timings for individual keystrokes

steps.action: Document functions requiring specific pointer path
steps.result: If function requires specific path (signature, drawing), keyboard alternative or alternative method must exist

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.1 Keyboard Accessible - 2.1.4 Character Key Shortcuts
tests.description: Guideline 2.1  All functionality of the content is operable through a keyboard interface without requiring specific timings for individual keystrokes, except where the underlying function requires input that depends on the path of the user's movement and not just the endpoints. Success Criteria: 2.1.4 Character Key Shortcut

steps.action: Identify single-key shortcuts (letter, number, or punctuation) implemented in the interface
steps.result: Each shortcut must be disableable, remappable, or active only while its component has focus

steps.action: Verify shortcuts do not interfere with screen readers or assistive tools
steps.result: Key combinations must avoid conflicts with assistive technology commands

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.2 Enough Time - 2.2.1 Timing Adjustable
tests.description: Guideline 2.2  Give users enough time to read and use content. Success Criteria:    2.2.1 Timing Adjustable

steps.action: Inspect session timeouts, automatic redirects, and meta http-equiv refresh tags on the page
steps.result: No timed meta refresh is present, and any session time limit can be turned off, adjusted to at least 10x the default, or extended with at least 20 seconds notice

steps.action: Verify prior warning before time expires
steps.result: System must alert with sufficient advance notice and allow simple extension (e.g., press button)

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.2 Enough Time - 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide
tests.description: Guideline 2.2  Give users enough time to read and use content. Success Criteria:    2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide

steps.action: Inspect carousels, auto-updating tickers, animations, and blinking/scrolling content lasting more than 5 seconds
steps.result: No <blink> or <marquee> elements exist, and any moving, blinking, or auto-updating content has a mechanism to pause, stop, or hide it

steps.action: Verify pause control is visible and keyboard operable
steps.result: Pause/play buttons must be clearly visible and accessible without mouse

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.2 Enough Time - 2.2.3 No Timing
tests.description: Guideline 2.2  Give users enough time to read and use content. Success Criteria:    2.2.3 No Timing

steps.action: Verify that all functionality and content can be used without any time limits
steps.result: Tasks must be completable without time restrictions or interruptions

steps.action: Document exceptions where time is a real-time requirement
steps.result: Only live essential events (e.g. real-time auctions) may be exempt; all others must have no timing

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.2 Enough Time - 2.2.4 Interruptions
tests.description: Guideline 2.2  Give users enough time to read and use content. Success Criteria:    2.2.4 Interruptions

steps.action: Trigger non-emergency notifications, promotional banners, or automatic page refreshes during a user task
steps.result: Interruptions and non-essential updates can be postponed or suppressed by the user without losing current task progress

steps.action: Verify notification preferences settings
steps.result: System must offer controls to manage frequency and type of interruptions

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.2 Enough Time - 2.2.5 Re-authenticating
tests.description: Guideline 2.2  Give users enough time to read and use content. Success Criteria:    2.2.5 Re-authenticating

steps.action: Let the session expire mid-task and log in again
steps.result: After re-authenticating, the user must continue the activity without losing previously entered data

steps.action: Test with long forms and verify data recovery
steps.result: In-progress information must be auto-saved or recoverable after relogin

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.2 Enough Time - 2.2.6 Timeouts
tests.description: Guideline 2.2  Give users enough time to read and use content. Success Criteria:    2.2.6 Timeouts

steps.action: Verify users are warned about session inactivity timeout
steps.result: A warning must be presented in time for the user to react (at least 20 seconds) via an accessible notification

steps.action: Verify user can save work before timeout
steps.result: Warning must include a clear option to save progress or extend the session

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.3 Seizures and Physical Reactions - 2.3.1 Three Flashes or Below Threshold
tests.description: Guideline 2.3  Do not design content in a way that is known to cause seizures or physical reactions. Success Criteria:    2.3.1 Three Flashes or Below Threshold

steps.action: Review site animations and transitions
steps.result: No content should flash more than 3 times per second

steps.action: Use PEAT (Photosensitive Epilepsy Analysis Tool) if available
steps.result: Analyze multimedia content to identify flashes that could cause seizures

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.3 Seizures and Physical Reactions - 2.3.2 Three Flashes
tests.description: Guideline 2.3  Do not design content in a way that is known to cause seizures or physical reactions. Success Criteria:    2.3.2 Three Flashes

steps.action: Thoroughly analyze animations, videos, and dynamic content
steps.result: No flash exceeding safe limits must exist, without exceptions

steps.action: Review embedded third-party content (ads, external videos)
steps.result: External content must not contain dangerous flashes or must be disableable

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.3 Seizures and Physical Reactions - 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions
tests.description: Guideline 2.3  Do not design content in a way that is known to cause seizures or physical reactions. Success Criteria:    2.3.3 Animation from Interactions

steps.action: Verify motion animations triggered by scroll or interaction
steps.result: User must be able to disable non-essential motion animations

steps.action: Verify respect for system prefers-reduced-motion preference
steps.result: Site must detect and respect OS setting to reduce motion

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks
tests.description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.1 Bypass Blocks

steps.action: Press Tab from the address bar on page load to check for a skip-to-main-content link and verify focus movement
steps.result: A skip link becomes visible on focus and activating it moves keyboard focus directly to the main content container

steps.action: Verify ARIA landmarks (main, nav, complementary, contentinfo)
steps.result: Structure must use landmark roles to enable quick navigation with screen readers

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.2 Page Titled
tests.description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.2 Page Titled

steps.action: Inspect the document <title> element in the DOM and observe title updates across SPA route changes
steps.result: Every page and view has a non-empty, descriptive <title> element that clearly identifies the current screen or step

steps.action: Verify title follows consistent format (content - section - site name)
steps.result: Titles must follow predictable pattern facilitating identification in tabs and history

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.3 Focus Order
tests.description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.3 Focus Order

steps.action: Navigate with Tab in order and verify visual logic
steps.result: Focus order must follow logical sequence left to right, top to bottom

steps.action: Identify elements with positive tabindex and evaluate necessity
steps.result: Avoid tabindex greater than 0, order must be controlled through logical DOM structure

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context)
tests.description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context)

steps.action: Inspect all <a href>, area[href], and role=link elements to verify their accessible name and destination context
steps.result: Every link has a non-empty accessible name that describes its purpose alone or together with its enclosing sentence/list item, and target=_blank links warn of new window

steps.action: Use screen reader to list all links
steps.result: Links must be understandable when presented out of context in link list

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.5 Multiple Ways
tests.description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.5 Multiple Ways

steps.action: Try to locate an internal page in different ways
steps.result: Navigation menu, internal search, sitemap, or breadcrumbs must exist

steps.action: Verify at least two navigation methods are available
steps.result: User must be able to choose between different strategies to locate content

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.6 Headings and Labels
tests.description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.6 Headings and Labels

steps.action: Verify page headings are descriptive and reflect the content structure
steps.result: Each heading must clearly describe the topic or purpose of its section

steps.action: Use screen reader to navigate by headings
steps.result: Heading structure must allow quick understanding of content organization

steps.action: Check labels of form fields and interactive controls
steps.result: All labels must be descriptive and clearly identify the control purpose

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.7 Focus Visible
tests.description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.7 Focus Visible

steps.action: Navigate with Tab and observe focus indicator
steps.result: Interactive elements must show clear contrasted visual indicator when focused

steps.action: Verify outline is not disabled without visual replacement
steps.result: If default outline is removed, equally visible alternative indicator must exist

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.8 Location
tests.description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.8 Location

steps.action: Navigate through different site sections and verify location indicators
steps.result: Breadcrumbs, section titles, or indicators showing user location must exist

steps.action: Review that breadcrumbs are accessible and reflect correct hierarchy
steps.result: Breadcrumbs must be keyboard navigable and structured with ordered list

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.9 Link Purpose (Link Only)
tests.description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.9 Link Purpose (Link Only)

steps.action: Inspect all links on the page in isolation (ignoring surrounding paragraph text) and compare links sharing the same accessible name
steps.result: Each link accessible name uniquely and clearly describes its destination on its own, and links with identical names point to the same resource

steps.action: Identify generic links ('more info', 'read more') and improve them
steps.result: Ambiguous links must include additional context via aria-label or aria-describedby

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.10 Section Headings
tests.description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.10 Section Headings

steps.action: Review content structure and heading usage
steps.result: Content must be organized with descriptive headings dividing information into logical sections

steps.action: Verify no long text blocks exist without intermediate headings
steps.result: Extensive content must be subdivided with headings facilitating scanning and navigation

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
tests.description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)

steps.action: Navigate with keyboard and verify focus visibility on elements near edges
steps.result: At least part of focus indicator must remain visible, not completely hidden by other elements

steps.action: Test navigation in areas with sticky headers or floating elements
steps.result: Sticky bars must not completely cover the focused element

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.12 Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced)
tests.description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.12 Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced)

steps.action: Verify focus is completely visible in all situations
steps.result: Focus indicator must be completely visible without any obstruction by other elements

steps.action: Implement auto-scroll when element receives focus outside viewport
steps.result: Content must auto-adjust to fully show the focused element

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.4 Navigable - 2.4.13 Focus Appearance
tests.description: Guideline 2.4  Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are. Success Criteria:    2.4.13 Focus Appearance

steps.action: Measure focus indicator area and contrast with specialized tools
steps.result: Indicator must have sufficient minimum area and high contrast for maximum visibility

steps.action: Calculate that indicator has minimum 2 CSS pixels perimeter or equivalent area
steps.result: Indicator thickness and area must meet specific WCAG 2.2 requirements

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.5 Input Modalities - 2.5.1 Pointer Gestures
tests.description: Guideline 2.5  Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.5.1 Pointer Gestures

steps.action: Identify functions activated by complex gestures (swipe, pinch)
steps.result: Functions must have alternative with simple single-point gestures (tap, click)

steps.action: Verify carousels, maps, and swipeable components
steps.result: Alternative buttons or controls must exist for users with motor limitations

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.5 Input Modalities - 2.5.2 Pointer Cancellation
tests.description: Guideline 2.5  Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.5.2 Pointer Cancellation

steps.action: Test activation of interactive elements
steps.result: Function must not execute on mousedown/touchstart, must allow cancellation by releasing outside target

steps.action: Verify accidental clicks can be cancelled by dragging outside
steps.result: User must be able to undo accidental activation by moving pointer before release

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.5 Input Modalities - 2.5.3 Label in Name
tests.description: Guideline 2.5  Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.5.3 Label in Name

steps.action: Compare the visible text label of every button, link, and form control against its computed accessible name (aria-label / aria-labelledby)
steps.result: For every control with a visible text label, the accessible name contains the exact visible text string (preferably at the beginning)

steps.action: Verify voice commands can activate controls using visible text
steps.result: Voice control users must be able to say visible text to activate element

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.5 Input Modalities - 2.5.4 Motion Actuation
tests.description: Guideline 2.5  Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.5.4 Motion Actuation

steps.action: Identify functions using accelerometer or gyroscope
steps.result: Functions activated by device motion must have standard UI alternative

steps.action: Verify setting to disable motion actuation
steps.result: User must be able to disable motion responses to avoid accidental activations

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.5 Input Modalities - 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced)
tests.description: Guideline 2.5  Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced)

steps.action: Measure dimensions of all pointer targets (buttons, links, controls)
steps.result: All targets must be at least 44x44 CSS pixels, except inline links within sentences or user-agent controlled elements

steps.action: Verify exceptions: inline text links, equivalent controls, or legal/presentation requirements
steps.result: If a target is smaller than 44x44, an equivalent alternative control with adequate size must exist

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.5 Input Modalities - 2.5.6 Concurrent Input Mechanisms
tests.description: Guideline 2.5  Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.5.6 Concurrent Input Mechanisms

steps.action: Test site with multiple simultaneous input devices (keyboard + mouse + touch)
steps.result: Site must support simultaneous use of different input mechanisms without restrictions

steps.action: Verify switching input method does not cause loss of functionality
steps.result: User must be able to freely switch between keyboard, mouse, and touch without issues

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.5 Input Modalities - 2.5.7 Dragging Movements
tests.description: Guideline 2.5  Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.5.7 Dragging Movements

steps.action: Identify drag and drop functions
steps.result: Drag and drop functions must have alternative with simple clicks or taps

steps.action: Test keyboard alternatives for reordering elements
steps.result: Reorderable lists must be manipulable with keyboard (arrows + Space/Enter)

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 2.5 Input Modalities - 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)
tests.description: Guideline 2.5  Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard. Success Criteria:    2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)

steps.action: Measure dimensions of touch controls (buttons, links)
steps.result: Touch targets must have minimum 24x24 CSS pixels or equivalent spacing

steps.action: Verify spacing between adjacent touch targets
steps.result: If targets are smaller than 24px, sufficient surrounding space must exist to avoid errors

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.1 Readable - 3.1.1 Language of Page
tests.description: Guideline 3.1  Make text content readable and understandable. Success Criteria:    3.1.1 Language of Page

steps.action: Inspect the <html> root element for the lang attribute (and xml:lang if present) in the DOM
steps.result: The <html> element has a non-empty, valid BCP-47 lang attribute matching the primary language of the document (and xml:lang matches if present)

steps.action: Verify correct pronunciation with screen reader
steps.result: Reader must use voice and pronunciation rules appropriate to declared language

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.1 Readable - 3.1.2 Language of Parts
tests.description: Guideline 3.1  Make text content readable and understandable. Success Criteria:    3.1.2 Language of Parts

steps.action: Locate passages, phrases, or terms written in a language different from the page primary language and inspect their [lang] attribute
steps.result: Every foreign-language passage or phrase (excluding proper names and technical terms) has a valid BCP-47 lang attribute on its container

steps.action: Test screen reader reading of quotes or terms in another language
steps.result: Language changes must be recognized and pronounced correctly

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.1 Readable - 3.1.3 Unusual Words
tests.description: Guideline 3.1  Make text content readable and understandable. Success Criteria:    3.1.3 Unusual Words

steps.action: Identify jargon, technical terms, or unusual words in content
steps.result: Glossary, inline definitions, or mechanism to explain uncommon terms must exist

steps.action: Verify accessibility of definitions through links or dfn/abbr elements
steps.result: Specialized terms must link to accessible explanations

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.1 Readable - 3.1.4 Abbreviations
tests.description: Guideline 3.1  Make text content readable and understandable. Success Criteria:    3.1.4 Abbreviations

steps.action: Locate abbreviations and acronyms in content
steps.result: First instance of abbreviations must include full expansion or link to definition

steps.action: Implement abbr element with title attribute where appropriate
steps.result: Abbreviations must be semantically marked for assistive technologies

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.1 Readable - 3.1.5 Reading Level
tests.description: Guideline 3.1  Make text content readable and understandable. Success Criteria:    3.1.5 Reading Level

steps.action: Evaluate text complexity and required reading level
steps.result: Complex content must have simplified version or summary for lower secondary education level

steps.action: Use readability analysis tools (Flesch-Kincaid, INFLESZ)
steps.result: Measure readability indices and provide alternatives for technical or complex content

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.1 Readable - 3.1.6 Pronunciation
tests.description: Guideline 3.1  Make text content readable and understandable. Success Criteria:    3.1.6 Pronunciation

steps.action: Identify words where pronunciation is critical for comprehension
steps.result: Mechanism to indicate pronunciation must exist (IPA, audio, phonetic text)

steps.action: Verify homographs and ambiguous terms with pronunciation guides
steps.result: Words with multiple pronunciations must be clarified when context is insufficient

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.2 Predictable - 3.2.1 On Focus
tests.description: Guideline 3.2  Make Web pages appear and operate in predictable ways. Success Criteria:    3.2.1 On Focus

steps.action: Navigate with Tab through interactive elements
steps.result: No element should cause context change (navigation, submission) just by receiving focus

steps.action: Verify form fields do not submit when focused
steps.result: Focus must be independent of activation, changes must only occur with explicit action

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.2 Predictable - 3.2.2 On Input
tests.description: Guideline 3.2  Make Web pages appear and operate in predictable ways. Success Criteria:    3.2.2 On Input

steps.action: Interact with forms and controls without activating submit button
steps.result: Field changes must not cause context change without prior warning or confirmation

steps.action: Test selects and radios that may cause automatic navigation
steps.result: If change causes action, prior warning or confirmation button must be required

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.2 Predictable - 3.2.3 Consistent Navigation
tests.description: Guideline 3.2  Make Web pages appear and operate in predictable ways. Success Criteria:    3.2.3 Consistent Navigation

steps.action: Compare menus and navigation across different pages
steps.result: Repeated navigation elements must appear in same order across all pages

steps.action: Document location of global elements (search, login, main menu)
steps.result: Common components must maintain consistent position and order throughout site

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.2 Predictable - 3.2.4 Consistent Identification
tests.description: Guideline 3.2  Make Web pages appear and operate in predictable ways. Success Criteria:    3.2.4 Consistent Identification

steps.action: Identify components with same function across different pages
steps.result: Equivalent components must use same labels, icons, and accessible names

steps.action: Verify consistency of icons and symbols throughout site
steps.result: Same icon must represent same function, avoid different symbols for identical actions

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.2 Predictable - 3.2.5 Change on Request
tests.description: Guideline 3.2  Make Web pages appear and operate in predictable ways. Success Criteria:    3.2.5 Change on Request

steps.action: Verify significant changes require explicit user action
steps.result: Context changes, submissions, or navigation must not occur without explicit confirmation

steps.action: Identify and fix automatic submissions or unexpected redirects
steps.result: User must initiate all important changes through clear buttons or links

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.2 Predictable - 3.2.6 Consistent Help
tests.description: Guideline 3.2 Predictable: Make Web pages appear and operate in predictable ways. Success Criteria: 3.2.6 Consistent Help (A) - If a Web page contains help mechanisms, and those mechanisms are repeated on multiple Web pages within a set of Web pages, they occur in the same relative order to other page content, unless a change is initiated by the user.

steps.action: Search for help mechanisms in different sections
steps.result: Help options must appear in consistent location throughout site

steps.action: Verify quick access to contact, FAQ, chat, or documentation
steps.result: Help must be available predictably in fixed location

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.1 Error Identification
tests.description: Guideline 3.3  Help users avoid and correct mistakes. Success Criteria:    3.3.1 Error Identification

steps.action: Submit form with intentional errors
steps.result: Errors must be clearly identified in text, visually marked, and announced to screen readers

steps.action: Verify error messages use aria-describedby or aria-invalid
steps.result: Errors must be programmatically associated with affected fields for assistive technologies

steps.action: Verify focus moves to first error or error summary
steps.result: After validation, user must be clearly directed to found problems

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions
tests.description: Guideline 3.3  Help users avoid and correct mistakes. Success Criteria:    3.3.2 Labels or Instructions

steps.action: Inspect all form controls (inputs, selects, textareas, custom ARIA inputs) for visible labels, required indicators, and format instructions
steps.result: Every data entry control has a persistent visible label programmatically linked to it, and required state or input format constraints are clearly stated before the field

steps.action: Verify fields with specific formats (date, phone, zip code)
steps.result: Fields with format requirements must include examples or input masks

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.3 Error Suggestion
tests.description: Guideline 3.3  Help users avoid and correct mistakes. Success Criteria:    3.3.3 Error Suggestion

steps.action: Trigger validation errors in forms
steps.result: Error messages must suggest how to fix the specific problem

steps.action: Evaluate message quality: must be specific and solution-oriented
steps.result: Errors must explain what is wrong and how to fix it, not just indicate there is an error

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.4 Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
tests.description: Guideline 3.3  Help users avoid and correct mistakes. Success Criteria:    3.3.4 Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)

steps.action: Complete financial or legal transactions if they exist
steps.result: Must allow reviewing, confirming, and correcting information before final submission

steps.action: Verify confirmation page with option to edit before final submission
steps.result: Critical data must be shown in summary with ability to go back and modify

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.5 Help
tests.description: Guideline 3.3  Help users avoid and correct mistakes. Success Criteria:    3.3.5 Help

steps.action: Search for contextual help in forms and complex tasks
steps.result: Available help must exist to complete tasks, visible or easily accessible

steps.action: Verify tooltips, help links, or info icons next to complex fields
steps.result: Help must be available in context where needed, not only on separate page

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.6 Error Prevention (All)
tests.description: Guideline 3.3  Help users avoid and correct mistakes. Success Criteria:    3.3.6 Error Prevention (All)

steps.action: Identify forms that modify, delete, or compromise user data
steps.result: Reversible mechanism (undo), verification (review before submit), or explicit confirmation must exist

steps.action: Test form submission with critical information
steps.result: System must present review screen where user can verify and correct before confirming

steps.action: Verify availability of option to revert completed actions
steps.result: Destructive actions must allow undo or have grace period before permanent execution

steps.action: Verify explicit confirmations for irreversible actions
steps.result: Deletions, transfers, or permanent changes must require clear and specific additional confirmation

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.7 Redundant Entry
tests.description: Guideline 3.3  Help users avoid and correct mistakes. Success Criteria:    3.3.7 Redundant Entry

steps.action: Complete multi-step forms
steps.result: Previously provided information must auto-complete or be selectable, not re-entered

steps.action: Verify data from previous steps is pre-filled in later steps
steps.result: User must not re-type name, address, or other already entered data

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.8 Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
tests.description: Guideline 3.3  Help users avoid and correct mistakes. Success Criteria:    3.3.8 Accessible Authentication (Minimum)

steps.action: Test login and authentication process
steps.result: Must offer accessible alternatives to visual CAPTCHA or cognitive tests (email, SMS, biometrics)

steps.action: Verify availability of magic link or OTP code authentication
steps.result: Alternative methods must be equally secure without requiring visual recognition

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 3.3 Input Assistance - 3.3.9 Accessible Authentication (Enhanced)
tests.description: Guideline 3.3  Help users avoid and correct mistakes. Success Criteria:    3.3.9 Accessible Authentication (Enhanced)

steps.action: Test authentication flows to confirm no cognitive function test is required at any step
steps.result: Login must not depend on memorization, transcription, or puzzle solving unless an accessible alternative or assistance is provided

steps.action: Verify password managers and copy-paste are fully supported in credential fields
steps.result: Users must be able to paste credentials or use password manager autofill/biometrics without restrictions

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 4.1 Compatible - 4.1.1 Parsing (Obsolete and removed)
tests.description: Guideline 4.1  Maximize compatibility with current and future user agents, including assistive technologies. Success Criteria:    4.1.1 Parsing

steps.action: Check the DOM for duplicate id attributes across active elements, labels, and ARIA IDREF targets
steps.result: All id attribute values in the document and open shadow roots are unique so label[for], aria-labelledby, and aria-describedby references never collide

steps.action: Review dynamically generated code with browser inspector
steps.result: JavaScript generating content must produce valid and well-formed HTML

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 4.1 Compatible - 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
tests.description: Guideline 4.1  Maximize compatibility with current and future user agents, including assistive technologies. Success Criteria:    4.1.2 Name, Role, Value

steps.action: Test custom widgets with screen reader
steps.data: axe-core (wcag412): area-alt, aria-allowed-attr, aria-braille-equivalent, aria-command-name, aria-conditional-attr, aria-deprecated-role, aria-hidden-body, aria-hidden-focus, aria-input-field-name, aria-prohibited-attr, aria-required-attr, aria-roles, aria-tab-name, aria-toggle-field-name, aria-tooltip-name, aria-valid-attr-value, aria-valid-attr, button-name, duplicate-id-aria, frame-title-unique, frame-title, input-button-name, input-image-alt, label, link-name, nested-interactive, select-name, summary-name, aria-roledescription
steps.result: Components must announce correctly with appropriate ARIA role, state, and properties

steps.action: Verify state changes are reflected in ARIA attributes
steps.result: Dynamic states (expanded, selected, pressed) must be updated programmatically

tests.title: TC - [A11Y] - 4.1 Compatible - 4.1.3 Status Messages
tests.description: Guideline 4.1  Maximize compatibility with current and future user agents, including assistive technologies. Success Criteria:    4.1.3 Status Messages

steps.action: Trigger dynamic messages (confirmation, error, loading)
steps.result: Messages must be announced in screen readers using appropriate ARIA live regions

steps.action: Verify correct usage of role=alert, aria-live=polite/assertive
steps.result: Critical messages use assertive, informational use polite, without moving focus

steps.action: Test with screen reader that announcements interrupt or wait appropriately
steps.result: Live regions must be configured by message urgency without causing excessive interruptions
